title: Low-GI Coronation Chicken Salad
description: Turmeric's active compound curcumin improves glycemic markers and insulin receptor activity, while almond fats provide monounsaturated lipid protection.
diabeticNotes: Classical British Coronation Chicken relies on high-sugar apricot jam and heavy commercial mayonnaise. Replacing them with whole milk Greek yogurt, curry powder, and portion-controlled dried apricots delivers intense aromatics with low glycemic load.

ingredients.name: poached or roasted skinless chicken breast, shredded

steps.title: Toast Flaked Almonds
steps.description: Toast flaked almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes until lightly golden. Set aside.

steps.title: Mix Curry Yogurt Dressing
steps.description: In a bowl, whisk Greek yogurt, aromatic curry powder, and a pinch of salt until smooth and creamy.

steps.title: Fold Chicken & Apricots
steps.description: Add shredded cooked chicken breast and finely chopped dried apricots to the dressing, folding until completely coated.

steps.title: Prepare Lettuce Cups
steps.description: Arrange crisp Romaine lettuce leaves across a wide serving plate.

steps.title: Spoon & Garnish
steps.description: Spoon coronation chicken salad into the lettuce cups and top with toasted flaked almonds.
